title: 第023章 这事实太残酷了第024章 李主任的武道铁拳
lines: 许主任都不在关注后续的赛事时，苏恒还在运转修为调养几身，不过他身侧其他18个阵法高台内，一道道身影又震惊的眼珠子都快掉出来了。
原本还在考虑该从哪方面入手去调理受损的灵星果树的于飞煌，目瞪口呆之余，还差点喷出一口老血来。
全明星联赛极度考验一个选手的心理素质，上午的理论测试，他们所有参赛者都能看到大屏幕上的即时分数变化，只是无法看到彼此的电脑屏幕，无法看各个对手做题的答案。
下午的实践赛也是如此。
他们在阵法高台保护下，做不到靠修为影响彼此的施术，却能从上空扩大的虚幻影响上，看到感受到对手们的行为动作。
那是放大了十倍的修为气机，强度没变化，只是波动更强烈了。
于飞煌就切身体会到了，苏恒释放出来的一级木神术，一级育灵术！
正因为感受清楚了苏恒的术法级别，他才崩溃啊！
这个该死的家伙，不是实践能力瘸腿么？偏科严重？按照真正的大学毕业生标准，连及格都有些不足呢。
现在这是什么鬼？1级木神术加育灵术，全国优秀！木神术一个最最最最重要的术法，能比肩一堆的1级明光术、1级离土术、1级化灵术等等综合效果！
于飞煌自己，众多普通灵术几乎全是0级精通，木神术和育灵术只有普通级别！
这差距太大了。大的他都有些小绝望了。
最终，于飞煌没有喷出上涌的热血，只是身子一摇晃，头都有些昏沉，他接受不了这样的事实。
这个参赛报名时还被他大肆嘲讽打击的家伙，不止在理论上能压制他，拿走了第一名，实践也要压制他？？
毕竟0级精通的明光术、变温术、离土术等等，你是要轮番施展，精确把握所有术法的快慢频率，火候等等，就像一场极为耗费心力精力的精密手术，中途不能出一点差错，就算你做到了完美，效果依旧远不如苏恒啊。
苏恒多轻松？不需要考虑任何次序火候快慢节奏，只要运转功法，打出一次木神术就行，轻松悠闲，效果还比他强大的多？
这事实太残酷了，残酷的于飞煌这个心高气傲的骄子，想当成昏迷不在观看世界。
于飞煌这样，和他相邻的王会更是一脸惨败之色，摇摇晃晃身形后退时，满嘴都是不可能，这不可能，这是幻觉的低语。
不久前在来的路上，他还大肆嘲讽，甚至说出了以后三年，他会认真学习让苏恒感受到什么是绝望，什么是差距。
这次实践赛他更信心满满，觉得碾压苏恒轻而易举，话都放出去了，还是在好几个同学跟班面前，现在呢？怎么会是他被苏恒碾压了？
王会靠着以前的家族资源倾斜，也掌握一两种1级术法，但那些不是木神术啊，不是木神术有个鸟用？
就像许主任和几个教授的对话，四个年级的3000多名灵木系学生，只有5人掌握了1级木神术。
但你若说普通术法如明光术之类？大四随随便便能拉出来二三百个掌握1级术法的！
江州理工，毕竟是全大明帝国数万座高校里，排名八十多的。
毕业时能掌握1级术法，放在全国都属于优秀？大四毕业生们并不难做到。只有木神术这么严苛重要的本源术法，才会是四个年级3000多人，加上苏恒只有5人掌握！
1级木神术，就算王会这样的富豪家庭，也没办法帮他培育出来。不然，你以为这一届大二灵木系学长，没有和王辉一样的富二代富三代？
一个木神术的暴露，就让王会如遭雷击，他更明白不管家族怎么给他提供资源，他也不会在短期内掌握，只要没能掌握1级木神术，那么在实践方面，苏恒就会遥遥领先！
所以？他参赛之前说的那些话，现在只会成为屁话和笑话，这次大赛后，苏恒依旧能领先于他，至少在时间上，会是王会长年累月去追赶前面那个大山！
嘭的一声轻响，连连后退到阵法保护圈的无形护盾上，王会才被惊醒，醒来后他依旧充满狼狈，仿佛脸上被啪啪啪狂删了十几个耳光似的。
疼，不止疼还有着难以形容的羞耻感。
苏恒的表现太打脸了啊！
这是把他的脸打的啪啪啪乱响，那件事没人知道的话，自然无所谓，偏偏宿舍楼外的冲突，他是当着好几个跟班的面说的，明大明嘲讽苏恒的！
当时苏恒说他若不是依仗家里资源，连那几个跟班都比不上，氛围已经很微妙了，现在实践上又被苏恒碾压？那几个跟班会怎么想？估计已经开始肆无忌惮的嘲讽他不自量力，坐井观天了吧？
越想越崩溃，王会嘴角一甜，真的溢血了，这是他性格太傲，从小到大都没出过这么大的丑，心性也不是那么稳，被刺激的一身修为暴乱，反噬受伤了。
王会的样子，也通过放大十倍的虚拟映像，清晰传遍了全场，不管是高台上的裁判们，还是看台上的几千观众，全都无语的看着这一幕。
几个呼吸后，沸腾的声响才席卷而出。
“怎么回事？我怎么看到王会吐血了？”
“噗~不至于吧，就算苏恒展露出这么恐怖的实力，能施展1级的木神术和育灵术，但也不至于刺激的王会吐血吧？”
“我去，认识近一年，这位富三代从没正眼看过我一次，每次都是无视，现在竟这么不堪？人家苏恒施展一轮术法，能打击的他溢血？太搞笑了吧？这心理素质太差了吧？”
“哈哈，太有意思了，我就说，他若不是家里富有，10岁就开始修炼比我多了太多资源，说不定连我都比不上呢，乖乖，这心理素质差的不敢想象。”
各式各样的声音从看台上传播出来，等部分看乐子的话语落入王会耳中，本就气机沸腾的王会，再次眼前一黑，天杀的，都是苏恒，都是这个贱民，不是他，他王会这样的天之骄子，怎么可能受到这样的羞辱？
王会满脑子一团乱时，苏恒已经睁开眼，顺顺利利运转1级木神术，后续1级育灵术，第二轮治疗下去，原本就恢复不少的灵星果树，短短十几秒就变得更加灵动而富有生机。
第二轮下去，苏恒的修为已经消耗了一半！
不过灵星果树垂死的伤势，也恢复了三四成了。
content_en:
While Director Xu was not paying attention to the subsequent events, Su Heng was still working on his cultivation and recuperating. However, in the other 18 formation platforms beside him, there were figures whose eyes almost fell out of shock.
Yu Feihuang, who was originally thinking about how to deal with the damaged Lingxing Fruit Tree, was stunned and almost spit out a mouthful of blood.
The All-Star League extremely tests a player's psychological quality. During the theoretical test in the morning, all the contestants could see the real-time score changes on the big screen, but they could not see each other's computer screens or the answers to each opponent's questions.
The same goes for the afternoon practice session.
Under the protection of the formation platform, they could not influence each other's spells through their cultivation, but they could see and feel their opponents' actions from the illusory influence that expanded from above.
It was a cultivation qi machine that was amplified ten times. The intensity did not change, but the fluctuations became more intense.
Yu Feihuang experienced it firsthand, the first-level wood magic and the first-level spiritual cultivation skill released by Su Heng!
It was precisely because he felt clearly the level of Su Heng's magic that he collapsed!
Isn’t this damn guy lame in practical ability? Seriously biased? According to the standards of real college graduates, even passing is a bit inadequate.
Now what the hell is this? Level 1 Wood Divine Technique plus Spiritual Nurturing Technique, excellent in the country! Wood Divine Technique is one of the most important and most important techniques. It can rival a bunch of Level 1 Bright Light Techniques, Level 1 Earth Leaving Techniques, Level 1 Spirit Transformation Techniques, etc. in terms of comprehensive effects!
For Feihuang himself, almost all of the common spiritual arts are at level 0, while the wood magic and spiritual cultivation skills are only at ordinary levels!
This gap is too big. He was a little desperate.
In the end, Yu Feihuang did not spurt out the hot blood, but only shook his body and his head felt a little dizzy. He could not accept this fact.
This guy who was ridiculed and attacked by him when he signed up for the competition could not only suppress him in theory and take the first place, but also suppress him in practice? ?
After all, level 0 proficiency in the Bright Light Technique, Temperature Changing Technique, Earth Lifting Technique, etc. requires you to perform them in turn and accurately grasp the speed, frequency, heat, etc. of all the techniques. It is like a precision operation that consumes a lot of energy and energy. You cannot make any mistakes in the middle. Even if you achieve perfection, the effect will still be far inferior to Su Heng.
How relaxed is Su Heng? There is no need to consider any order, speed, or pace of fire. All you need to do is run the skills and cast the Wood God Technique once. It is easy and leisurely, and the effect is much more powerful than him?
This fact is so cruel. The cruel Yu Feihuang, a proud and arrogant man, wants to pretend that he is unconscious and not watching the world.
When Yu Feihuang was like this, Wang Hui, who was next to him, looked even more defeated. When he staggered back, his words were all impossible, this is impossible, this is the whisper of an illusion.
On the way here not long ago, he made fun of him and even said that in the next three years, he would study hard to make Su Heng feel what despair is and what gap is.
This time in the practice competition, he was even more confident. He felt that it would be easy to crush Su Heng. Even though he had said it out loud, it was still in front of several classmates and followers. What now? How could he be crushed by Su Heng?
Wang Hui relied on his previous family resources and also mastered one or two level 1 spells, but those were not Wood Divine Techniques. Wasn't it that Wood Divine Techniques were useless?
Just like the conversation between Director Xu and several professors, out of more than 3,000 spiritual wood students in four grades, only 5 have mastered level 1 wood magic.
But what if you talk about ordinary spells such as bright light spells? A senior can easily pull out two to three hundred masters of level 1 spells!
After all, Jiangzhou University of Technology ranks in the 80th among tens of thousands of universities in the entire Ming Empire.
Being able to master level 1 magic upon graduation is considered outstanding in the country? It’s not hard for seniors to do it. Only such a strict and important original technique as Wood Divine Technique can be mastered by more than 3,000 people in four grades, plus Su Heng only has 5 people!
Even a wealthy family like Wang Hui couldn't help him cultivate level 1 wood magic. Otherwise, do you think that in this class of sophomore Lingmu Department seniors, there are no rich second-generation and rich third-generation people like Wang Hui?
The exposure of a wood magic technique made Wang Hui feel like he was struck by lightning. He understood that no matter how the family provided him with resources, he would not be able to master it in a short period of time. As long as he could not master the level 1 wood magic technique, Su Heng would be far ahead in terms of practice!
so? The words he said before participating in the competition will only become nonsense and jokes now. After this competition, Su Heng can still be ahead of him. At least in terms of time, it will be Wang Hui who has been chasing the mountain in front of him for many years!
There was a soft bang and he retreated to the invisible shield of the formation's protective circle. Wang Hui was awakened. After waking up, he was still full of embarrassment, as if his face had been slapped a dozen times.
It hurts, not only the pain but also the indescribable shame.
Su Heng's performance was so disappointing!
This was a slap on his face. If no one knew about it, it wouldn't matter. But for the conflict outside the dormitory, he said it in front of several followers. Ming Daming mocked Su Heng!
At that time, Su Heng said that if he had not relied on family resources, he would not be able to compare with those few followers. The atmosphere was already very delicate, but now he is actually being crushed by Su Heng? What would those followers think? He must have started to ridicule him unscrupulously for not overestimating his abilities and looking at the sky from a well, right?
The more he thought about it, the more he collapsed. The corner of Wang Hui's mouth turned sweet, and his blood really overflowed. This was because he was too arrogant. He had never been so ugly since he was a child, and his temperament was not so stable. When he was stimulated, his cultivation went riot, and he was injured in the backlash.
Wang Hui's appearance was also clearly broadcast throughout the entire venue through a virtual image that was enlarged ten times. Whether it was the referees on the high platform or the thousands of spectators in the stands, they all watched this scene speechlessly.
After a few breaths, the boiling sound swept out.
"What's going on? Why did I see Wang Hui vomiting blood?"
"Pfft~ That's not the case. Even if Su Heng shows such terrifying strength and can perform level 1 wood magic and spiritual cultivation skills, it won't be so exciting that the king will vomit blood, right?"
"Let me go. I have known him for nearly a year. This rich third generation has never looked at me once. He ignored me every time. Now he is so unbearable? Su Heng used a round of magic to hit him and he bled? Isn't it too funny? Isn't his psychological quality too poor?"
"Haha, that's so interesting. I'll tell you, if his family wasn't rich and he started practicing at the age of 10 and he has so many more resources than me, he might not even be able to compare with me. Darling, I can't imagine his poor mental quality."
…………
Various sounds spread from the stands, and when some of the fun words fell into Wang Hui's ears, Wang Hui, who was already furious, once again blacked out. God damn, it was all Su Heng, this untouchable, not him. How could a proud man like Wang Hui be so humiliated?
While Wang Hui's mind was filled with confusion, Su Heng had already opened his eyes and was smoothly operating the Level 1 Wood Divine Technique, followed by the Level 1 Spirit Nurturing Technique. After the second round of treatment, the Spirit Star Fruit Tree, which had already recovered a lot, became more agile and full of vitality in just ten seconds.
After the second round, Su Heng's cultivation level has been consumed by half!
However, Lingxing Fruit Tree's dying injuries have also recovered to 30% to 40%.
title_en: Chapter 023 This fact is too cruel Chapter 024 Director Li’s martial arts iron fist
